# JEStats Astra DB Plugin

> Unofficial, community-maintained integration by JEStats (https://jestats.io), not affiliated with or endorsed by DataStax or IBM. The MCP server (`@erichare/astra-mcp`) and agent plugin give coding agents live access to Astra DB: schema inspection, filtered queries, vector and hybrid search, guarded writes and schema changes, interactive MCP Apps views, and about 1,660 documentation-derived Data API examples for Python, TypeScript, Java, C#, and Go. Works with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Claude Desktop, IBM Bob, and, through a hosted OAuth endpoint, ChatGPT and claude.ai.

Install: `npx -y @erichare/astra-mcp init` configures detected agents, then `login` writes ASTRA_DB_APPLICATION_TOKEN, ASTRA_DB_API_ENDPOINT, and ASTRA_DB_KEYSPACE to a git-ignored .env. Tokens are never pasted into chat. Destructive operations (drop, bulk update/delete) require the user's confirmation.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/jestatsio/astra-db-plugin/blob/main/README.md): overview, quickstart, supported agents
- [Tools reference](https://github.com/jestatsio/astra-db-plugin/blob/main/docs/tools.md): all 18 tools, arguments, confirmation flow, error codes
- [Configuration](https://github.com/jestatsio/astra-db-plugin/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): credential resolution order, variables, manual agent setup
- [Security model](https://github.com/jestatsio/astra-db-plugin/blob/main/docs/security.md): writes, confirmations, credential guard hook, hosted OAuth
- [Hosted server](https://github.com/jestatsio/astra-db-plugin/blob/main/docs/hosted.md): OAuth, headers, self-hosting on Vercel
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/jestatsio/astra-db-plugin/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): error codes and fixes

## Skills

- [astra-toolkit](https://github.com/jestatsio/astra-db-plugin/blob/main/skills/astra-toolkit/SKILL.md): Data API data modeling (Collections vs Tables), Astra CLI, architecture, and client examples with per-language indexes
- [astra-widgets](https://github.com/jestatsio/astra-db-plugin/blob/main/skills/astra-widgets/SKILL.md): interactive views for overview, schema, explorer, and search results
